description: A tool for managing PS2 memory card images like the ones the PCSX2 emulator uses (`Mcd001.ps2`). It imports and exports save games, and it can also create, inspect and check card images.  This is a port of Ross Ridge's mymc 2.7 from Python 2 to Python 3, with a working graphical interface on wxPython 4 and a new cross-platform 3D save icon viewer.
